blocks.text: Legit Status Varsity, a Filipino street dance and hip-hop team, made history by becoming the first Filipino team to win the 18-and-Under Advanced Category at the UDO World Street Dance Finals, held n August at Blackpool’s Winter Gardens in the United Kingdom. This is proof that Filipino Street Dance is no longer just a subculture, it’s becoming a global competitive force. This recent victory in the UK reflects more than a championship. It is a story of discipline, collective ambition, and a generation redefining what Filipino excellence can look like. 24 young Filipinos had one job: show the world what they […]...
